tagline.en: StarVLA — a vision-language-action policy built on Qwen3-VL that turns camera views and instructions into robot actions.
tagline.zh: StarVLA——基于 Qwen3-VL 的视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机画面与指令转化为机器人动作。

en: StarVLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied control. It takes visual observations plus a language instruction and predicts the actions a robot should execute, using the Qwen3-VL-4B vision-language model as its backbone.

The main policy checkpoint, Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1, is trained on the LIBERO manipulation benchmark and runs in an OFT (optimized fine-tuning) prediction route. A companion world-action variant (WM4A, MIT-licensed) pairs the policy with a Wan2.2 video model to model how actions play out in the world. Predictions are returned both in environment-space and normalized form, with unnormalization driven by the checkpoint's statistics.
In WorldFoundry the policy and world-action code run inference-only in-tree, so you can drive the model with local checkpoints without a separate upstream checkout.
zh: StarVLA 是面向具身控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它接收视觉观测加一条语言指令，预测机器人应执行的动作，主干采用 Qwen3-VL-4B 视觉语言模型。
主策略 checkpoint Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1 在 LIBERO 操作基准上训练，以 OFT（优化微调）路线做动作预测。配套的 world-action 变体 WM4A（MIT 许可）将策略与 Wan2.2 视频模型结合，用以建模动作在世界中的展开。预测同时返回环境空间与归一化两种形式，反归一化由 checkpoint 统计量驱动。
在 WorldFoundry 中，策略与 world-action 代码以推理模式内置运行，你可以用本地 checkpoint 直接驱动模型，无需单独拉取上游代码。

whenToUse.en: Use StarVLA when you need a VLA policy that maps images and language instructions to robot actions, particularly for LIBERO-style manipulation tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个把图像与语言指令映射到机器人动作的 VLA 策略时，尤其针对 LIBERO 类操作任务，可选择 StarVLA。

notFor.en: Heavy to run — the policy is built on a 4B vision-language model and was exercised on an 80GB GPU; you also need to stage the checkpoints and base VLM locally.
notFor.zh: 运行开销较大——策略建立在 4B 视觉语言模型之上，需在 80GB 级 GPU 上运行；同时需在本地准备好 checkpoint 与基座 VLM。

en: Vision-language-action policy on a Qwen3-VL-4B backbone
Optional world-action variant with a Wan2.2 video model (MIT license)
Returns both environment-space and normalized actions
zh: 基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 主干的视觉-语言-动作策略
面向 LIBERO 操作训练（4-in-1 checkpoint）
